newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybeans fall, corn, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybeans fall, corn, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean values were slightly lower while corn and wheat values were steady in quiet dealings, export sources said.
Exporters said farmer sales tapered off after sharp losses in CBOT corn and soybeans but channels remained well stocked.
Trade sources said they were surprised by news a U.S. firm had purchased 45,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans for import into the U.S. but some were skeptical the beans would actually be shipped.
"People here are just trying to figure out if they're really going to ship them," one exporter said.

Exporters and traders said the buyer may opt to send the soybeans to Rotterdam instead. If U.S. prices fall to a level where there is no longer a premium over Brazilian supplies, it would be more profitable to send the beans to Europe instead.
